answer: At dawn each epoch, agents must post a shale-backed bond whose size scales with their claimed liquidity buffer, and a random ledge of pending multi-unit auctions is audited for duplicate collateral fingerprints. Sybil identities therefore cannot reuse the same shale collateral across pseudonyms without tripping cross-epoch correlation checks that freeze the shared buffer. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
